name: NG exhaustion higher-order chain study contract
purpose: Discover how far predictive dependence propagates from one exhaustion episode through higher-order behavior, freeze the actual chain boundaries first, and only then categorize the discovered chains by their characteristics.

observation_stream.origin: first actual NG trade after the Sunday weekly reopen
observation_stream.end: last actual NG trade before the genuine weekly close
observation_stream.holiday_special_sessions: follow actual trade stream, never assumed clock time

event_detection.signal: trailing-20-second aggressor-volume imbalance from MBP-10 trade price versus concurrent top-of-book midpoint
event_detection.orientation: event polarity from roll20 sign at t0
event_detection.threshold: 85th percentile of absolute roll20 within each UTC source date, preserving the existing frozen-event detector convention
event_detection.prominence: absolute t0 roll20 minus median absolute roll20 over t0-30..t0-10
event_detection.week_continuity_extension: candidate windows, prominence history, roll20, and refractory selection may cross UTC-date boundaries; day-native thresholding does not create a chain reset
event_detection.target_day_equivalence: compare continuous-week detected target-day events against the frozen 3429-event reveal+holdout roster and fail closed on unexplained interior mismatches

phase_1_chain_discovery.goal: find the chains themselves: origin, descendants, link depth, and reset point
phase_1_chain_discovery.principle: chain membership and reset are determined by whether information inherited from earlier links continues to add reproducible out-of-sample predictive information about subsequent event/tape behavior beyond what the most recent event alone provides
phase_1_chain_discovery.lineage_measure: for each candidate descendant depth, compare predictive information from the current event alone against the current event plus progressively older ancestors; record incremental out-of-sample gain and uncertainty
phase_1_chain_discovery.reset_definition: the first point where ancestor information no longer adds reproducible predictive value beyond the current event becomes a candidate reset; reset must replicate and cannot be created by a clock/date/file boundary
phase_1_chain_discovery.depth_definition: chain depth is empirical and continues only while inherited information survives with adequate sample support

phase_2_characterization.goal: describe and categorize already-discovered chains based on the characteristics they actually exhibit
phase_2_characterization.rule: characteristics may explain, distinguish, or name a frozen chain type, but cannot retroactively move its boundaries or create a chain that phase 1 did not find

event_annotations.pre_family: retain frozen operational A/B/C for later characterization only
event_annotations.a_post_state: retain frozen A +60 state for later characterization only
event_annotations.validated_aftermath_role: benchmark/post-hoc interpretation only; never a phase-1 chain cell or boundary rule
event_annotations.dynamic_endpoint: three consecutive causal forward-filled oriented roll20 <= 0; record structural onset and causal confirmation

fields: seconds and hours since first Sunday-reopen trade

chain_representation.structural_sequence: all detected exhaustion events ordered continuously inside the trading week
chain_representation.overlap: record whether a descendant event starts before the ancestor exhaustion endpoint confirms
chain_representation.executable_link: record whether predecessor information used for a prediction was causally known before descendant t0
chain_representation.raw_characteristics_preserved: retain rich causal event/tape measurements in the canonical data so phase 2 can characterize frozen chains without rebuilding or changing phase-1 boundaries

validation.phase_1_method: leave-one-trading-week-out replication of lineage/incremental-information survival and reset points
validation.phase_2_method: profile frozen phase-1 chain IDs and test whether discovered characteristic differences replicate across weeks
validation.higher_order_promotion: requires replication beyond one week and eventual forward-live validation

parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.lineage_discovery: find chain boundaries/depth from inherited predictive information only; output frozen chain IDs
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.reset_falsification: independently challenge lineage/reset points and search for false persistence
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.tape_linkage: measure whether tape outcomes propagate across already-discovered links without defining the chains
parallel_lanes_after_canonical_table_fre.posthoc_characterization: only after chain IDs freeze, categorize them using polarity, flow, book, shape, duration, time, and other observed characteristics
